name: Map
use: Use for going to one of many places that have a layout, where it is matters, and each has a status to see before the tap: Farrowing's and Inspection's Pen map. A menu drawer: the legend, the Entrance band and the map, with Back in the footer, and Whole room beside it when the map is more than two screens tall.
notUse: Not for places with no layout or a list to read (use ChoiceList or Row · navigation); not for a few fixed choices of one list (use Segment); not for status that needs words (put it in the peek or on the page the tile opens).

name: Whole room
use: Use for a room more than two screens tall pen by pen: the map adds Whole room beside Back, which shows the room on one screen with neighbouring pens of a run sharing a tile (A11–20), each pen a mark in its status colour. A tap on a shared tile goes back to pen by pen at that tile.
notUse: Not for a room of two screens or less (it has Back alone); not as a second map of a different room or a summary of the room (use the room page); never as the only way to a pen (a pen is opened pen by pen).
